profile.summary: Kaiser Foundation Hospitals is a nonprofit that is part of Kaiser Permanente, a large health care organization based in Oakland, California. Kaiser Permanente combines health insurance and medical care. Kaiser Foundation Hospitals operates its hospitals, and it works alongside Kaiser Foundation Health Plan, Inc. and the Permanente Medical Groups.
